limitations: Synthetic service fixture; no AWS account was queried.
Only selected EC2, Auto Scaling, ELBv2, RDS and regional tagging APIs are collected; other services and global routing are not covered.
Tagging API does not return all untagged or unsupported resources; explicit service APIs supplement it.
Configuration observations are not an atomic snapshot and do not establish workload paths, measured transaction capacity or recovery guarantees.
Launch-template versions/user data, scaling schedules, warm pools, listener non-default rules, IAM policies and network reachability are not collected.
